issue.title: Project label audit rejects the archived-prompt repair storage identity
issue.description: PR #299 floor-smoke run 38982644527 has 1 failed / 831 passed; sole failure is repair_archived_prompt_path deriving Path(project_file).parent.name in src/sase/ace/tui/actions/hints/_view_target_repair.py. The result feeds hidden_sidecar_clone_dir(project_key, AGENTS_SIDECAR_ROLE), not a displayed project name. tests/_project_display_presentation_audit_path_labels.py requires every identity derivation to have a deliberate exemption and rationale but this new site was omitted. Reproduces in Master Gate 38983979564 and isolated on f6ff20ef2a. Review all consumers and add the precise identity-only exemption (or route through the established identity helper with corresponding audit entry); retain existing real label-leak guards and logical-plan/archive repair tests. Do not replace the storage key with a human display label. Release integration repair may close this task after verification.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Static AST audit unconditionally reports the new unallowlisted storage-identity expression; same exact failure in floor smoke, Master Gate, and isolated local pytest.

issue.creation_reason: The sase-1lh.7 lander traced the canceled release watch to this deterministic floor-smoke failure, introduced outside the release epic by a9701c36e6.
